title: Read hosted plans
responsibility: Validate committed plans and turn their current designs into catalog planning records.

inputs.name: hubPlans.context
inputs.description: Authorized source context with repository, pinned commit, tree entries, source adapter and cache identity.

inputs.name: hubPlanRecord.context
inputs.description: Authorized source context with repository, pinned commit, tree entries, source adapter and cache identity.

inputs.name: hubPlanRecord.plan
inputs.description: Validated plan whose design versions and current contract are needed.

outputs.name: hubPlans
outputs.description: Plans from the supported category folders after schema, path, contract-hash and duplicate-identity checks.

outputs.name: hubPlanRecord
outputs.description: Plan record with versions, latest contract fields/hash, empty local threads and draft/review/approved lifecycle determined by its latest design and current approval.
